g.text: GPU frame timing events: two timestamp pairs to GpuFrameTiming
[both slots still bound to a fence]
bind the pair to the submission's fence value
the GPU executes the recorded events
signal V when this submission completes
collect after completion, without a host wait
keep only a newer V per cache
deliver the sample to the client
Best effort: a 4-query pool serves 2 in-flight pairs.
A reset or result error disables timing for the renderer
